## Auth SLO Targets
- Password sign-up completion rate: >= 95% over 30 minutes.
- Email confirmation completion rate: >= 90% over 1 hour.
- Password sign-in completion rate: >= 95% over 15 minutes.
- Password reset completion rate: >= 90% over 30 minutes.
- Session refresh post-processing completion rate: >= 99% over 15 minutes.
